_comment: Decorators are enabled here rather than in the shared base because apps/api is
the only consumer: TypeORM entities declare their columns with them. These are
the legacy semantics TypeORM requires, not the ES standard ones.
emitDecoratorMetadata is deliberately off. It exists so an ORM can infer a
column's type from the property's, and every column and relation here states
its type outright instead. Leaving it on emits a direct reference to each
property's class, which throws on any entity that names one declared later in
